items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Penny, look, would you like to take this over for me for awhile now?

ctx.x: Penny, look, would you like to take this over for me for awhile now? I just want to make one or two phone calls, and what Eddie's going to talk about is after this, continued arranging through '50s and '60s, and playing with Swingers, Inc.
